leadText: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! (Japanese: 劇場版ポケットモンスター キミにきめた！ Pocket Monsters the Movie: I Choose You!) is a adaptation of the movie of the same name. It is adapted by Ryo Takamisaki. It started serializing on July 2, 2017 in MangaONE, a Japanese manga smartphone app by Shogakukan. The English release combines both parts of the Japanese release into one volume and was released on December 11, 2018.
plainText:
Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! (Japanese: 劇場版ポケットモンスター キミにきめた！ Pocket Monsters the Movie: I Choose You!) is a adaptation of the movie of the same name. It is adapted by Ryo Takamisaki. It started serializing on July 2, 2017 in MangaONE, a Japanese manga smartphone app by Shogakukan. The English release combines both parts of the Japanese release into one volume and was released on December 11, 2018.

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
and Cross first encounter each other at Professor Oak's Laboratory. 
Cross received his from .
With the exception of capturing , the montage of Ash and 's journey before going to the Pokémon Center is skipped over entirely.
In the , Ash never meets . In the manga, he briefly sees them at the Pokémon Center, though he never encounters them again.
Verity and Sorrel are first seen when Ash encounters instead of showing up at the Pokémon Center.
Verity's mother is never brought up.
Cross does not learn that Ash possesses the Rainbow Wing at the library.
Agatha's cameo appearance as Ash's teacher in the nightmare sequence is omitted.
The brief battle between Ash and Pikachu against is not shown.

==Translation edits==
===Errors===
In the English version, Sorrel erroneously refers to Ash's Charmeleon as Charmander during its battle with Cross's .
